item.title: C Programming: Decode sscanf %n for Input Parsing
item.description:
“C Programming: Decode sscanf %n for Input Parsing”

When working with string input in C, parsing data accurately is paramount. The sscanf function, a powerful tool for extracting formatted input from strings, offers a unique specifier, %n, that provides invaluable control over the parsing process. This feature allows you to determine how many characters have been successfully read by sscanf up to that point, which is particularly useful for iterative parsing or when you need to track progress within a string.
